properties.name: Aral Sea
properties.note: The Aral Sea before it started to shrink. The shape is that of about 1960. The map shows it for all earlier years, as an estimate.

properties.name: Aral Sea
properties.note: In these years the sea became smaller. This map has no shape for these years yet, so the shape of 1960 is shown. By 2000 the sea had lost more than half of its area.

properties.name: Dead Kultuk and the Kaydak Inlet
properties.note: Dead Kultuk and the Kaydak Inlet before they dried out. This is an estimate. The shape is that of September 2000, and the bays were larger than this when the sea was high. From the 1930s the Caspian Sea fell, and the bays dried out. The year 1939 is an estimate.

properties.name: Dead Kultuk and the Kaydak Inlet
properties.note: The Caspian Sea rose from 1978 to 1995, and the bays filled again. This is an estimate. The shape is that of September 2000, and the year 1985 is an estimate. From 1940 to 1984 the map shows the bays dry.

properties.name: Dead Kultuk and the Kaydak Inlet
properties.note: Dead Kultuk and the Kaydak Inlet in September 2000, traced from satellite pictures of NASA. The two bays of the Caspian Sea are shallow: they fill when the sea is high and dry out when it is low.
